events.title: Live Now: Gods of the Grid Next Fest demo
events.summary: Hi, I’m Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid on my own.I’m playing the Next Fest demo live. Come and watch a run from the Underworld all the way to Kronos at the Titans’ Gate, and ask me anything in chat: builds, bosses, how a spell works.Gods of the Grid is a match-3 roguelite RPG set in Greek myth. events.title: Hits that land harder, a Temple that never runs out
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid. Here is what has changed since the last post.DEVOTIONS: THE TEMPLE NEVER RUNS OUTOnce every blessing in the Temple is at its top level, Devotions become available. There are four ranks with no limit, and they add health, starting armor, damage and healing to every run. events.title: Ten new boons, spells you can rearrange
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid.The last post was about the demigod picker and smoother fights. This one is about more choices inside a run, a spell bar you arrange yourself, and a long list of rules the game now keeps exactly as its cards state them. TEN NEW BOONSEvery level-up offers you one of three boons. There are ten more in the pool now. events.title: A new way to choose your demigod, much smoother battles
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid.The last post was about what the game shows you. This one is about the screen a run begins on, how a fight feels, and numbers you can trust.A NEW WAY TO CHOOSE YOUR DEMIGODThe picker used to show one demigod at a time behind two arrows, with six of the seven hidden. events.title: A title screen, a board that warns you, and a run that remembers itself
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid.The last post was about combat. This one is about what the game shows you, what it remembers, and how well it runs.THE GAME OPENS ON A TITLE SCREENSteam, the desktop build and the browser version all open on a title screen now, and it is there from the first frame while the rest loads. events.title: Every fight has been rebalanced
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I make Gods of the Grid on my own.The last post was about what you play with. This one is mostly combat.OLYMPUS IS THE SUMMIT NOWMount Olympus used to be the third realm you walked through. It is now the last, with Zeus at the top as the final fight of a run, bringing the lightning that scrambles the board. The Frozen Reach takes the third place he left behind, and three new Olympians guard the way: the Hora of the Gate, an Aegis Bearer, and a Gigas of Phlegra. Every real

events.title: Truly distinct classes, twenty new relics, and a fight you can pause
events.summary: Hi, I'm Alexandros, and I am the creator of Gods of the Grid.A busy week. The last post was mostly about how the game looks and how it is controlled. This one is mostly about what you actually play with.EVERY DEMIGOD NOW FIGHTS WITH FOUR SPELLS OF THEIR OWNUntil now each demigod carried three shared spells and one signature. That made the class you picked matter far less than it should. Each one now has a full set of four, built around a single way of playing. Athena turns armour into a weapon.
